message: Architecture block discovery paused before VHDL generation. The reviewer judged the auto-discovered block contracts as a poor fit.

issues.message: Discovered blocks: control_fsm, program_memory_interface, data_memory_interface. Missing blocks after review: instruction_fetch, instruction_decoder, alu, register_file, branch_handler, cpu_top. Risks: Auto-discovered contracts are generic FSM wrappers that do not provide CPU-specific datapath ports (address/data buses, control signals).; Critical CPU components are missing: fetch unit, decoder, ALU, register file, and branch logic.; Reset polarity mismatch: discovered blocks use active-low rst_ni, conflicting with the synchronous active-high reset requirement.; Memory interfaces lack explicit address/data ports required for a functional CPU core.; No explicit interconnect or pipeline stage definitions between fetch, decode, execute, and write-back..
